name: enterprise-brain
title_zh: 问一句就知道该派哪个AI员工干活的调度台
tagline_zh: 别在十几个Agent之间猜来猜去。问它一句，自动路由到对的人；新员工入职、改全队规则、查记忆归属，都在这一个入口。
tagline_en: Stop guessing which agent does what. Ask in plain words, get routed to the right one. Onboard new hires, change.
desc_en: The control plane for a fleet of AI-employee agents. Use this skill whenever the principal wants to route a request to the right agent, asks "which agent should do this", "who owns this", stands up or edits a new AI employee, asks about the roster / org / fleet, changes a fleet-wide rule, or asks how each agent's memory is stored, namespaced, read or written. why_zh: 把Agent当团队管：有花名册、有分工、有统一规则。你只说要什么，它负责找到那个该干活的，不用记谁是谁。
why_en: Treats agents like a real org: roster, ownership, shared rules. You state the goal, it finds the responsible agent—no need to.
limit_zh: 只做路由和治理，不执行具体任务；需要已有Agent注册在案，新Agent得先定义职责和能力边界。
limit_en: Routing and governance only, no task execution. Requires agents registered in the roster; new agents need defined roles. Unknown requests return 'no.
title_en: Ask once, it routes to the right AI employee
